@liuli.dismiss.description: Button that dismisses a banner or toast.

@liuli.details.description: Button that shows or hides a banner's details.

@liuli.close.description: Button that closes a viewer or sheet.

@liuli.search.description: Accessible name of a list's search field.

@liuli.noMatches.description: Shown in place of a list when nothing matches the search.

@liuli.stop.description: Button that stops a reply being written.

@liuli.date.description: Accessible name of the date part of a date and time field.

@liuli.time.description: Accessible name of the time part of a date and time field.

@liuli.chooseFiles.defaultMessage: {multiple, select, yes {Choose files} other {Choose a file}}
@liuli.chooseFiles.description: Button that opens the file picker; `multiple` is yes when it takes several files.

@liuli.removeNamed.description: Button that removes the item named `name`.

@liuli.uploadingNamed.description: Progress ring of the file named `name` being sent.

@liuli.add.description: Button that adds an item to a list.

@liuli.removeItem.description: Button that removes the list item at position `number`, from 1.

@liuli.decrease.description: Stepper button that lowers a number.

@liuli.increase.description: Stepper button that raises a number.

@liuli.page.description: A page button or dot; `page` from 1.

@liuli.pictureOf.description: Which picture a viewer shows; `page` from 1.

@liuli.itemOf.description: Which item a carousel shows; `page` from 1.

@liuli.clearSearch.description: Button that empties a search field.

@liuli.clear.description: Button that empties a text field.

@liuli.hidePassword.description: Button in a password field that hides the typed password again.

@liuli.showPassword.description: Button in a password field that shows the typed password as text.

@liuli.next.description: Tour button to the next step.

@liuli.back.description: Tour button to the step before.

@liuli.backTo.description: Row above a submenu that has taken a phone menu's place; `parent` is the menu's name.

@liuli.skip.description: Tour button that ends the tour early.

@liuli.done.description: Tour button on the last step.

@liuli.monthName.defaultMessage: {month, select, jan {January} feb {February} mar {March} apr {April} may {May} jun {June} jul {July} aug {August} sep {September} oct {October} nov {November} dec {December} other {}}
@liuli.monthName.description: A month's name, as a date or a calendar title shows it.

@liuli.weekdayName.defaultMessage: {weekday, select, sun {Sunday} mon {Monday} tue {Tuesday} wed {Wednesday} thu {Thursday} fri {Friday} sat {Saturday} other {}}
@liuli.weekdayName.description: A weekday's name, read with a calendar day.

@liuli.weekdayInitial.defaultMessage: {weekday, select, sun {S} mon {M} tue {T} wed {W} thu {T} fri {F} sat {S} other {}}
@liuli.weekdayInitial.description: A calendar column's weekday heading, one letter or character.

@liuli.calendar.day.description: A calendar day's accessible name; `today` is yes for today.

@liuli.timestamp.justNow.description: A moment less than a minute ago.

@liuli.timestamp.minutesAgo.defaultMessage: {minutes, plural, one {# minute ago} other {# minutes ago}}
@liuli.timestamp.minutesAgo.description: A moment earlier today, in minutes.

@liuli.timestamp.hoursAgo.defaultMessage: {hours, plural, one {# hour ago} other {# hours ago}}
@liuli.timestamp.hoursAgo.description: A moment earlier today, in hours.

@liuli.timestamp.yesterday.description: Said with the time for a moment yesterday.

@liuli.timestamp.time12.description: A time on a 12-hour clock; `minute` has two digits.

@liuli.timestamp.dateTime.description: A date and a time together.

@liuli.video.auto.description: The quality choice that adapts to the connection.

@liuli.video.failed.defaultMessage: This video cannot play right now
@liuli.video.failed.description: Message when the video cannot play.

@liuli.video.fullscreen.description: Button that shows the video full screen.

@liuli.video.live.description: Badge on a live stream; any capitals come from its style.

@liuli.video.loading.description: Spoken status while the video loads.

@liuli.video.quality.description: Menu heading for the video quality choices.

@liuli.video.rate.description: Menu heading for the playback speed choices.

@liuli.video.replay.description: Button that plays an ended video again.

@liuli.video.retry.description: Button that tries to play a failed video again.

@liuli.video.seek.description: Spoken name of the slider that moves through the video.

@liuli.video.settings.description: Button that opens the playback settings menu.

@liuli.video.unmute.description: Button that turns the video sound back on.

@liuli.step.done.description: Spoken state of a finished step in a stepper.

@liuli.step.current.description: Spoken state of the step in progress.

@liuli.step.upcoming.description: Spoken state of a step not yet reached.

@liuli.cancel.description: Button that backs out of a confirmation without doing anything.

@liuli.actionFailed.description: Shown in a confirmation dialog when its action fails.

@liuli.clearField.description: Button inside a choice field that empties it; `label` is the field's label.

@liuli.copy.description: Button on a code block that copies its code.

@liuli.copied.description: Shown for a moment after a code block's code is copied; also the copy button's name meanwhile.

@liuli.sort.description: The sort control's name in a stacked Table, and its menu's; the trigger's label before a column is chosen.

@liuli.sortBy.description: A sortable Table heading's name while the rows are not ordered by it; `column` is the heading.

@liuli.sortedAscending.description: A Table heading's name while the rows are ordered by it, smallest or first first; `column` is the heading.

@liuli.sortedDescending.description: A Table heading's name while the rows are ordered by it, largest or last first; `column` is the heading.

@liuli.sortAscending.description: Button beside a stacked Table's sort menu while the order is descending: turns it round.

@liuli.sortDescending.description: Button beside a stacked Table's sort menu while the order is ascending: turns it round.

@liuli.selectAll.description: The checkbox above a selectable Table's rows; checked when every row is, mixed when some are.

@liuli.selectRow.description: A selectable Table row's checkbox; `row` is the row's first field.

@liuli.loadingNamed.description: Said while a component's content loads; `name` is the component's label.

@liuli.chart.other.description: The slice of a pie chart that gathers the parts past those drawn on their own.
